Pause twice to compute the Friedmann integral from Planck's sound horizon (showing why Early Dark Energy must shrink the pre-recombination sound horizon by 7.7% and why it worsens S8 clustering) and calculate how 50 inclination-constrained gravitational-wave bright standard sirens break the electromagnetic distance ladder at >6 sigma alongside MOND's galactic transition scale. Weigh SH0ES's 5-sigma Cepheid crisis (73.04 km/s/Mpc) against Wendy Freedman's JWST TRGB/JAGB counter-audit (68.8–70.4), DESI's 2.5–3.9 sigma evolving dark energy (w0 > -1, wa < 0) hints, and Stacy McGaugh's razor-thin SPARC Radial Acceleration Relation—closing with a pre-registered 2030 arbitration protocol and a field guide to spotting hidden cosmological battles inside routine astrophysics papers.

item.description: Why are citizens of Switzerland or the United States roughly 30 to 100 times richer than citizens of Burundi or the Democratic Republic of the Congo—even across twin towns like Nogales sharing identical sun, soil, and history? This five-act adversarial deep dive places Daron Acemoglu, Simon Johnson, and James A. Robinson's 2024 Nobel-winning institutional thesis on full courtroom trial. Walk through the foundational fortress—Colonial Origins (2001), Reversal of Fortune (2002), Rodrik, Subramanian & Trebbi's 'Institutions Rule' (2004), and Melissa Dell's landmark Econometrica spatial discontinuity across Peru's colonial mining mita (-25% consumption and +6 percentage points child stunting two centuries after abolition)—before unleashing the sharpest counter-evidence in political economy. Pause twice to compute the exact 2SLS Wald multiplier (7.9x from Nigeria to Chile), exclusion-restriction bias magnification, and Fieller weak-instrument infinity threshold (F < 3.84) exposed by David Albouy's 2012 archival audit of 36 imputed observations—and engineer a clustered spatial RDD power calculation (340 villages) correcting Morgan Kelly's 3x spatial-autocorrelation t-statistic mirage. Weigh Edward Glaeser and Andrei Shleifer's Human Capital rebuttal, Jeffrey Sachs's exogenous Anopheles Malaria Ecology, and East Asia's authoritarian growth miracles—closing with a de-bundled tri-mechanism protocol and a field guide to spotting hidden institutional-vs-geography battles inside everyday economics papers.

item.description: Does predicting the very next word across trillions of internet tokens force neural networks to build genuine, causally editable internal world models—or merely colossal, brittle statistical lookup tables masquerading as thought? Starting from the collapse of classical bias–variance overfitting theory and Jared Kaplan's astonishing 2020 discovery of unbroken seven-order-of-magnitude cross-entropy power laws, this five-act adversarial deep dive traces DeepMind's Chinchilla compute-optimal scaling revolution, Jason Wei's emergent capability thresholds, Neel Nanda's surgical activation-patching proof of linear editable board states inside Othello-GPT, and Wes Gurnee & Max Tegmark's unified geographic and temporal coordinate maps inside Llama-2—before unleashing the sharpest empirical counterattacks in modern AI. Pause twice to compute exact iso-compute Chinchilla vs. Gopher loss surfaces (saving 0.0465 nats at 4x lower inference cost!) and walk through Rylan Schaeffer's exact-match exponentiation mirage (turning smooth per-token loss into an illusory leap from 0.25% to 54.88%) alongside paired McNemar power engineering for contamination-free symbolic trials. Weigh Emily Bender's Stochastic Parrots critique, Apple's GSM-Symbolic audit (up to 65% accuracy collapse from a single irrelevant clause), and The Illusion of Thinking's puzzle-horizon breakdown in frontier Large Reasoning Models—closing with a pre-registered counterfactual-patching arbitration protocol and a field guide to diagnosing AI papers in disguise.
